comment.text: Grd floor shop offices to rear (offices changed by previous owner to a private residence with agreement with CO) residential and 2'ary shop accommodation at upper levels (now business use). Deep glazed display cabinet to rear R (rear cabinets removed by previous owner to reinstate front door of residence). Grd floor - shop to front with raised room at right (returned by previous owner  to hall of residence) raised dispensing department to the rear. Front display window with glazed doors (removed by present owner) into shop. Fitted glazed cabinets to right wall, shelving to left wall (removed by present owner replaced with modern mahogany effect shelves) & dispensary drawers (re-positioned by present owner  in dispensary above modern shelves). Free-standing glazed mahogany framed cabinets as display counters (replaced by present owner with modern shelves). Rear shelving with mirrored back and raised sign that reads 'DISPENSING DEPARTMENT' (removed by previous owner agreed with CO).
